chapters.title: Chapter 3915: Battlefronts! I
paragraphs: The air between them thrummed with something that transcended power- it was older than authority, deeper than dominion, and more fundamental than the very concept of existence itself!
Sigrid felt her being respond to it tremendously, every fiber of her existence yearning to surrender to the pull of whatever Noah was.

Her hands trembled as she gazed at his, watching the way reality seemed to bend around his fingers like light refracted through the purest crystal. The aura that emanated from him was unlike anything she had ever encountered in all her life, all her careful observations of the Living Existences who had shaped her destiny.
What was he...really?!

The question burned in her mind even as her body betrayed her, swaying slightly toward him despite her will. Her existence- that carefully controlled amalgamation of Living Origin, Order, and purpose that had been forged in the crucible of her family’s sacrifice- hummed with an almost musical resonance that matched the rhythm of his presence.
She was in trouble! Deep, unfathomable trouble that went beyond the weavings of politics or power struggles or the machinations of Royal Living Existences!
"Are you..." Her voice emerged as barely more than a whisper, the words catching in her throat as she fought against the overwhelming urge to simply lose herself in the depths of his being.
"Are you in any way similar to me? Where this distinction was given to you recently, or have you always been...an Early Creature?"
The question hung between them like a blade suspended by the finest thread. Everything- her future, her choices, perhaps her very Existence, depended on his answer.

If he was one of the ancient beings, the true Early Creatures of legend who had walked between the Folds when the Existence was young, then she was nothing more than a moth drawn to a flame that would consume her without even noticing her passing.
Noah’s smile was gentle, as if he understood the weight of her question and the fears that drove it.
"I only recently attained the distinction of being an Early Creature."
WAA!
The relief that flooded through her was so profound it nearly brought her to her knees. Her shoulders sagged as tension she hadn’t even realized she was carrying drained away!
For a moment, she simply breathed, allowing the knowledge to settle into her.
"Why does that matter?" Noah asked, his head tilting slightly as he studied her with those impossibly deep eyes of an Early Creature.
Sigrid looked up at him, and for yet another instance...allowed vulnerability to show in her expression.

"I... would have found it immeasurably difficult to know how to proceed with you if you were one of those ancient Early Creatures I’d only ever heard about in legends," she said, her voice growing stronger with each word. "But if, like me, this identity was forced upon you or obtained through circumstance... then we are not so different after all."
She paused, gathering her thoughts like a scholar preparing to recite from sacred texts.

"You see, I feel as though I have a choice now. If you had been some primordial being from the dawn of Existence, it would have been akin to me simply playing in the palm of one of those terrifying entities I’d heard stories about. The records I knew, whether true of false, spoke of some wonders and terrible truths about the ancient Early Creatures."

"That they...treated Living Existences like playthings- dolls to be experimented upon, commodities to be traded between themselves for amusement or advancement. We were cared for, yes, but only as beautiful toys are revered by children who grow bored and break them when the novelty fades."
HUUM!
"They only truly respected each other. To them, everything else was lesser, decorative perhaps, but ultimately disposable. And lastly..." Her voice dropped to barely above a whisper.

"Early Creatures were incapable of true companionship because their core weavings traced back to the Earliest Creature itself- to Everything. To be with them was to be absorbed, to trust them was to lose oneself completely."
She searched his face, looking for any flicker of the cold indifference she had been taught to expect from beings of such power.
"But you... you’re not that, right?"
Noah’s response was immediate, his voice carrying the weight of absolute certainty. "No. I am more than capable of companionship. And respect, when mutual, is both given and received."
His eyes held hers with an intensity that was both gentle and overwhelming, and she found herself almost lost in their depths, drowning in the promise of understanding and acceptance they offered!
She nodded.

"But still," she said, forcing herself to focus on the larger picture, on the responsibilities that had been carved into her very soul through sacrifice and loss, "all the Living Origins look at me like some answer. Some ultimate solution. They expect me to become THE Living Order and somehow fix everything that Paradox made wrong so many eons ago. But..."

The rest of her words were cut off as Noah moved closer, his hands rising to frame her face with a gentleness that belied the quintessential forces at his command. Their faces were suddenly inches apart, and she could feel his breath against her skin.
The aura of an Early Creature made all parts of her being buzz!
"You are bound to me," he said, "You are mine. Whatever responsibility others have forced upon your shoulders, you do not have to bear that weight unless you choose to."

"If you were to make the choice right now," he continued, his voice dropping to barely above a whisper, "I could take you to a place where no Living Existence could ever find you. You could do whatever you wanted, be whoever you chose to be, without ever having to worry about becoming anyone’s chosen vessel or predetermined savior."
HUUM!
The offer hung between them like a lifeline thrown to a drowning soul!

She could see in his eyes that he meant every word, that he possessed both the power and the will to spirit her away from all of this- the expectations, the burden, the weight of an entire force pressing down upon her shoulders.
Her eyes trembled as the full implications of his words sank in.

He could do it. He really could take her away from all of this, give her the freedom she had never dared to dream of. For a moment, she allowed herself to imagine it- a life without the constant pressure of existence, without the ghost of her sacrificed family haunting her every decision, without the crushing responsibility of becoming something she had never asked to be.

But even as the temptation flowed through her veins like the sweetest poison, she steeled herself against it. Her existence, which seemed to be unbearably drawn to his, fought against her as she forced herself to speak.
"What you offer is tempting," she said with a sad smile, "If things were different, I would have gladly taken your hand and never looked back."
But.
Her expression grew cloudy.

"My becoming THE Living Order... it’s not simply to become what the Living Origins want me to become. I need that power, that distinction, so that I can hold the Royal Living Origins accountable for their role in my family’s sacrifice. For standing by and watching as my entire lineage burned themselves to ash so that I might live. They must pay for their complicity in that tragedy!"
BOOM!
Her hands clenched at her sides, and when she spoke again, her voice carried the cold and calm fury of existence.

"I also want that power because I do want to rectify the chaos that Paradoxes and Inevitabilities have wrought upon existence. The Loom, the constant threat of collapse, all the things that drove my entire lineage to the desperate act that created me- I want to see them all undone. Not for the Living Origins’ vision of order, but for the memory of my sister, my father, my mother...those who wrongfully died to give me this chance."
Her eyes blazed with fierce determination as she looked at him, and Noah found himself nodding slowly, understanding flickering in his gaze.

"Then I will help you," he said simply, moving closer until his nose brushed against hers, until she could feel the warmth of his skin and the steady rhythm of his breathing. "Because you are bound to me. Your goals become my goals. Your vengeance becomes my vengeance. Okay?"
The question was soft, almost tender, but it carried with it promise beyond imagination!
Her body shuddered at his words, at the casual way he offered to reshape existence itself for her sake!
When she whispered her answer, it came out as barely more than a breath against his lips.
"Okay."

The moment the word left her lips, his mouth found hers, and existence exploded into brilliance. White-gold radiance erupted around them like a Wheel of Existence being born, wrapping their figures in a cocoon of pure luminescence that pulsed with the rhythm of two existences becoming something greater than the sum of their parts.
In that kiss, in that moment of perfect unity, the fate of many things was sealed...and the foundations of new weavings of existence were laid down magisterially!

chapters.title: Chapter 3916: Battlefronts! II
paragraphs: In the channel leading to the Transcendent Origin Battlefront Folds.

Altheon’s awareness pressed against the barrier like fingers testing the surface of still water, his ancient mind cataloguing every ripple of power that emanated from within as he did not dare to observe anything, but could somewhat gues what was happening within.
He sighed- for any displays of emotion were beneath a being of his stature, but somewhere in the depths of his existence, duty and desire waged their war.
The Young Miss. Even now, the title carried reverence that made his very essence tremble.
She was not merely a unique Living Origin, though that alone would have commanded the devotion of many. No, she was something far more precious, far more dangerous.
The Living Order.
Not just any Living Order, but THE Living Order- the singular axis upon which the balance of all Living Existences that was broken long ago...would one day turn!

Her potential was whispered among the highest echelons of Living Origins, a promise of restoration that entire Folds had died hoping to witness. And now, in this critical moment of her emergence, she chose to enclose herself with... him.
Altheon’s luminous gaze traced the smooth curve of the barrier, behind which the Young Miss conversed with the Fold Dweller he had protected from Royal Origin Calypso’s scrutiny.

Noah Osmont. The name tasted strange in his thoughts, carrying with it an inexplicable weight that made his ancient intuition prickle with unease. There was something about that being that simply felt off!
The way he carried himself. His attitude. As if even a Living Origin like him was nothing.

The Young Miss was no child. Her mind was sharp as the edge of existence, her will forged in the crucible of unimaginable loss. She knew precisely what she was doing, had calculated every angle, every consequence. But that knowledge did nothing to ease the knot of frustration that coiled in Altheon’s core!
At this moment, when her emergence into the greater weavings of existence required the utmost care, she chose intimacy over glory. Privacy over prudence.
It maddened him.
But he...had already made his choice. And now, he could only continue!

"Young Miss," he called out, his voice carrying across the flowing channels of white-gold current with the authority of eons. The words rippled through the barrier like stones cast into a mirror-still pond, yet returned to him unchanged, unanswered.
Silence!
The channel around them pulsed with its own rhythm, each fold of current breathing in and out like the chest of some slumbering titan.
Rivers of light twisted through the medium, yet within that barrier, all was still!
"Young Miss," Altheon tried again, his tone carrying the weight of urgency now. "We are arriving in the Transcendent Origin Battlefront Folds."
A heartbeat passed. Then another. Existence held its breath.
Only then did the white-gold barrier begin to fade. The light peeled away in layers, each one revealing more of the figures within until finally, Noah and Sigrid stood before him in perfect clarity.

Noah’s eyes met his with that same infuriating calm that had marked their every interaction, a slight smile playing at the corners of his mouth as if he found some private amusement in Altheon’s obvious displeasure.
His hand, and here Altheon’s luminous gaze sharpened to a razor’s edge, still held hers, their fingers intertwined with an intimacy that spoke of far more than casual conversation.
The taste and smell of her still lingered on Noah’s lips, Altheon realized with a surge of something dangerously close to protective fury.
HUUM!
The Young Miss of the Living Origins- his Young Miss, the treasure of all Living Origins, had been touched by this Fold Dweller!

When Altheon’s gaze shifted to Sigrid, however, his anger cooled into something far more measured. Her eyes held that familiar sharpness, that calculating intelligence that had marked her since the moment she awakened in the Living Origin Labyrinth.
She was not some lovesick child overcome by passion. Whatever had transpired within that barrier had been her choice, made with full knowledge of its implications.

"Young Miss," Altheon said, his voice carefully neutral as his gaze pointedly fixed on their joined hands. "Many will be observing you, even though I have informed only Royal Origin Calypso and Duke Gwendolyn of your survival. I will keep my promise and say nothing regarding your... relationship. But if you express it so openly, you will invite tremendous difficulty for yourselves."
The words fell between them like executioner’s blades. Sigrid’s eyes sharpened, her grip on Noah’s hand tightening as if he had just spoken of stripping away some precious privilege.
He did not know how enticing thr Aura of an Early Creature was!
Yet Noah, with that maddening serenity that seemed to be his trademark, simply released her hand.
The gesture was smooth, unhurried, as if the separation meant nothing to him. As if he understood the game they were all playing and found it amusing rather than threatening.
Altheon nodded curtly, then allowed his Living Origin Authority to burst around them in a cocoon of brilliant radiance.
The final transition was always the most jarring- the moment when one stepped from the relative safety of the channels into the true weavings of war.
"Brace yourselves," he murmured, though his words were lost in the building crescendo of power.
BOOM!
Complex weavings of existence erupted around them like fireworks of pure existence, reality bending and folding as they were hurled across Existence.

The sensation was that of being turned inside out and reassembled in the space between heartbeats, every atom of their beings scattered and reformed according to the will of forces beyond comprehension.
And then, stillness!
They materialized atop a massive white triangular rune, its surface carved with intricate patterns that pulsed with the rhythm of some Existential heartbeat.
Smoke and mist swirled around their bodies, carrying with it the scent of glory and possibility.

Around them, other figures were taking shape- Master Neinoro with his pristine white robes and calculating smile, dozens of other Originus Venerant entities from Folds scattered across the breadth of existence!
But Noah’s attention was already elsewhere, his gaze lifting to take in the wonder that stretched before them with the slow glory of one witnessing new weavings of existence.
Something...gloriously new.
This...he loved!

chapters.title: Chapter 3917: Battlefronts! III
paragraphs: The sky above was a weaving of impossible beauty, stretching endlessly in all directions and shot through with rivers of sparkling white and gold light.
These celestial streams flowed like liquid starlight, weaving between and around nine massive continents that hung suspended in the void like the crown jewels of existence itself.
Each landmass was surrounded by dozens of Wheels of Existence, slowly rotating constructs of pure authority that pulsed with their own inner radiance.
Every continent thrummed with vibrant Living Existential Authority, each one a distinct note in a symphony of power that made the very air burn with potential.
Before each floating realm, massive banners unfurled, their fabric woven from light itself and bearing names that commanded reverence across all of existence!
ORIGIN. ELEMENTAL. LAW. EMOTIVE. CONCEPTUAL. SPIRITUAL. TEMPORAL. DIMENSIONAL. QUANTUM!
Nine sources of ultimate authority, representing every facet of existence save one- the Paradox that was deemed too vile and dangerous to be granted sanctuary in this place of ordered purpose.
Before each continent, floating in positions of glorious vigil, stood statues of breathtaking majesty.
These were embodiments of the Living Existences themselves, each one carved from materials that he wanted to turn into Loot!

The statue representing Origin stood with six wings of pure white marble spread in perfect symmetry, twelve halos of gold rotating slowly around a form so idealized it seemed to contain the template from which many points of beauty was measured.
Its face was serene, eyes closed as if in meditation, hands folded in a gesture that spoke of patience and boundless grace.
For Elemental, a massive spirit of living flame danced in perpetual motion, its form shifting between states of Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter with each passing moment.
The very air around it shimmered with heat, a warmth that spoke of comfort and destruction in equal measure!

The statue of Law stood rigid and perfect, its form carved from what appeared to be living silver that reflected truth itself. Sixteen wings of geometric precision extended from its shoulders in mathematically perfect angles, while eight halos of burnished platinum rotated with clockwork precision.
Its eyes were open, boring into the distance with a gaze that seemed to weigh the worth of every Existence within its sight.
Emotive swayed with graceful fluidity, its form seeming to shift between different emotional states with each breath.
Carved from what looked like crystallized tears, it bore fourteen wings that changed color with each movement- now deep blue with sorrow, now brilliant gold with joy, now crimson with passion.
The Conceptual statue defied easy description, its form seeming to exist in multiple dimensions simultaneously.
What appeared solid from one angle became translucent from another, as if the very idea of statue was being explored and redefined with each viewing.
Spiritual floated rather than stood, its form composed of what looked like condensed starlight wrapped in flowing robes of stellar dust. It looked tribal and holy at the same time!

Temporal existed in a constant state of flux, its form aging and growing young in an endless cycle that spoke to the nature of time itself. Sixteen wings stretched from its back, each feather showing a different moment in history, while eleven halos spun at different rates around its head- some so fast they appeared as solid rings, others so slow their movement was barely perceptible.
To look upon it was to feel the weight of every second that had ever passed and the promise of all those yet to come.
Noah shook his head at these achievements of Living Existences as he continued looking!

Dimensional seemed to exist in multiple realities at once, its form flickering between different versions of itself as parallel possibilities played out in real time. Eighteen wings of crystalline structure extended from its back, each one existing in a slightly different dimension, while thirteen halos phased in and out of visibility as they moved between planes of existence.
The very space around it seemed to fold and unfold, creating pockets of reality that contained entire Wheels of Existence.

And finally, Quantum- a being that defied all attempts at singular description. Like some cosmic entity torn from the depths of Existence, its form was a constantly shifting mass of multicolored energy that pulsed with the rhythm of probability itself. Nine wings spread from its back, each one containing swirling Omniverses of potential futures, while fifteen halos of pure possibility spun around its head in patterns that hurt to contemplate directly.
To observe it was to feel the weight of infinite possibility pressing against the boundaries of one’s comprehension!
Noah’s gaze swept across these impossible wonders, his eyes coming down and taking in the dozens of other massive runic platforms that dotted the void around them similar to where he stood.
Each one pulsed with different Living Existential Authority- triangles, squares, hexagons, and shapes that existed beyond conventional geometry.
They were the arrival points for Fold Dwellers from across the breadth of existence, each one marked with the signature of its origin point.
And there, at the center of it all, surrounded by the nine massive continents and their statue guardians, rose a citadel that defied every attempt at adequate description.
Even he had to appreciate this grand construct as his eyes flashed with the authority of the Weaver of Existence, seeking its identity as it rose up before his eyes!
|Aeternitas Concordia- The Living Harmony.|
HUUM!
Aeternitas Concordia!
It stretched toward the skies! The city seemed to exist in perfect balance, its architecture a seamless blend of every Living Existence’s aesthetic sensibilities.
Nine distinct sections spiraled outward from a central core, each one bearing the hallmarks of its patron power while somehow maintaining perfect harmony with the whole.

The Origin quarter gleamed with pristine white marble veined with gold, its towers rising in elegant spires. Bridges of crystallized light connected floating platforms where beings of pure radiance moved with the unhurried grace of those who had transcended the need for haste.

Law’s domain stood in perfect geometric precision, every angle calculated to mathematical perfection, every surface reflecting immutable truths that governed existence itself. The buildings seemed to have been constructed and assembled according to principles that existed before the first stone was laid!
There were other unique areas but...
Each quarter told its own story, yet all harmonized into a symphony of purpose that culminated in the massive tower at the city’s heart.
This central tower rose impossibly high, its surface a constantly shifting amalgamation of every material, every concept, every possibility that the nine Living Existences represented.
At its peak, a light burned that was not quite light- more a crystallization of purity and complexity.
As Noah and all others marveled at this...
Altheon materialized before them in a burst of white and gold radiance, his luminous eyes sweeping over every Fold Dweller present with the weight of ancient authority.
When he spoke, his voice carried the resonance of a heavy decree.
"Welcome to the Transcendent Origin Battlefront Folds. One of the largest Battlefront Folds in all Transcendent Folds."
He raised one hand, pointing toward the magnificent citadel that dominated the center of this impossible realm. The gesture was simple, yet it carried with it the weight of existence itself.

"There stands Aeternitas Concordia- the Living Harmony. Within its halls, you will find your Sponsors and receive your designations. From that moment forward, you will be taken to your proper roles and granted contact with the Living Existences themselves before you begin making your way out of this place...and towards the Doorways of the Loom filled with Inevitabilities!"
HUUM!

The implications hung in the air like incense, heavy with promise and threat in equal measure. This was the moment of transformation, the threshold between what they had been and what they might become.

"Go," Altheon commanded, his voice carrying the finality of judgment itself. "When you pass through the Living Coalition Gateway, your initial designation will be granted, and everything else will follow."
He looked calmly towards the Fold Dwellers with sharp eyes before he disappeared!
"Good luck."

chapters.title: Chapter 3918: Aeternitas Concordia! I
paragraphs: The absence left by Altheon’s departure was immediate and palpable.

Noah’s gaze swept across the impossible view of Aeternitas Concordia, his eyes catching every detail with the methodical precision of one who understood that knowledge was power, and power was survival.
From his vantage point atop the triangular runic platform, he could observe the intricate dance of arrival and ascension that played out across this realm of infinite possibilities.

Other platforms materialized in brilliant flashes of authority- some bearing entire contingents of Fold Dwellers who moved with the coordinated precision of military units, others delivering solitary figures whose very presence seemed to bend reality around them.
Each arrival told a story. The group that emerged from a hexagonal platform of crystallized time moved with the measured cadence of those who had learned to navigate temporal folds.

A lone figure stepping from a sphere of living shadow carried herself with the fluid grace of one who had danced with entropy and emerged unscathed. Another cluster, their forms wreathed in elemental fury, bore the scars of battles fought in the elemental folds.
All of them, every single one, had earned their passage here through trials within Doorways!
They were the survivors who had looked into the abyss of Imitation Mutated Inevitabilities and emerged victorious!
Soon, they would all ascend to Aeternitas Concordia and receive their designations- labels that would define their roles in the weavings of war that stretched toward the Loom itself.
Noah found himself genuinely curious about what designation awaited him and Sigrid.

Would their origins in the Nullvein Gravewake Folds mark them as outcasts from Paradoxical Folds, or would Altheon’s subtle machinations behind the scenes provide some measure of protection for the one he called Young Miss?
The thought of Altheon brought a different sort of contemplation to Noah’s mind, one that carried with it the cold clarity of long-term planning.
The Prime Living Origin had played his role admirably thus far, bowing to Sigrid’s authority while maintaining the careful facade of respectful distance for Noah.
But Noah had not forgotten that this same being had tried to kill his other self, Ozymandias, not so long ago!
Altheon had acted without knowledge of who he truly faced, yes, but ignorance was no absolution for attempted killed of he- Noah Osmont!
In his mind, the Prime Living Origin was already marked for death, a sentence waiting to be carried out when the moment was right.
For now, though, Altheon served a purpose.
He was a tool- useful, efficient, and perfectly positioned to provide protection for him and Sigrid while maintaining the illusion of propriety.
If he proved valuable enough in that role, Noah was not averse to postponing his execution indefinitely. Tools, after all, were only discarded when they broke or outlived their usefulness.
And if the day came when Altheon needed to be removed from the equation... well, Noah had Moiraine for precisely such situations.

The Living Golden Paradox had already proven her capability by eliminating one of her own kind with surgical precision. A Prime Living Origin would present no greater challenge to her particular skills!
The thought brought a slight hum to his lips, a sound of quiet satisfaction that was lost in the glorious symphony that surrounded them.
He was preparing to move toward Aeternitas Concordia, to take Sigrid and begin their ascent into whatever wonder awaited them, when a familiar voice cut through his contemplations.

"Miss," came the oily tones of Master Neinoro, his approach heralded by the rustle of pristine white robes and the calculated smile that had become his trademark. "You can always come with us to receive your designation under the Living Laws. We wouldn’t want you to experience any hardship if you travel with others and receive no designation or worse yet, be labeled as coming from Paradoxical Folds."
HUUM!
The audacity of this fucker was immense.
Here, in this moment of glorious significance, this insignificant creature had the unmitigated gall to waste their time with his machinations!
The ingratiating smile, the false concern, the barely veiled threat disguised as helpful advice- it was all so predictably pathetic.
Noah could see Sigrid’s annoyance building, her stellar eyes darkening.
She was preparing to deliver what would undoubtedly be a devastating verbal assault, but Noah had enough of this guy.
"I’ve heard enough bullshit from you already," he said, his voice carrying the weight of absolute finality as he stepped forward.
His gaze locked onto Master Neinoro’s confident expression with the precision of a hunter sighting prey. "So for now, stay here and do not move a step."
The words hung in the air for a heartbeat, deceptively simple in their construction.
Then Noah allowed a fragment of his true nature to surface- just enough to make his point with crystalline clarity!
HUUM!
The aura of an Early Creature could be expressed in many ways. When wielded with benevolent intent, it could fill even Living Existences with euphoria so profound they would weep tears of pure joy.
But when turned to darker purposes, when infused with the cold displeasure of a being whose very existence predated the concept of authority itself...
Master Neinoro froze mid-breath.
His confident smile cracked like glass subjected to impossible pressure, the carefully constructed mask of superiority dissolving to reveal the stark terror beneath.

His eyes- those calculating orbs that had gazed upon Masters of Existence with casual disdain- now trembled like leaves in an existential hurricane as they stared at Noah with the horrified recognition of prey that had finally glimpsed its predator!
And it would not even know what type of predator had locked onto it!

The effect was immediate and absolute. Every muscle in Neinoro’s body locked in place, held rigid by an instinctive understanding that to move, to speak, to even breathe too loudly might attract the attention of something that could erase him from existence with less effort than it took to blink.

Noah nodded at the sudden, blissful quiet that followed. Without another word, he beckoned to Sigrid, and together they began their ascent toward Aeternitas Concordia, leaving behind a cluster of shock and confusion!
Behind them, Neinoro’s entourage rushed to his aid, shaking him, calling his name, trying desperately to break whatever weaving had fallen over him.

Their voices carried notes of genuine alarm as they struggled to understand why their leader- a being who commanded respect across multiple Wheels and Fold Dwellings, was cowering before what appeared to be nothing more than a Paradoxical Fold Dweller!
Many of them cast wary glances toward Noah’s retreating figure, their earlier dismissiveness replaced by a caution born of witnessing power they couldn’t comprehend.
But Noah paid them no mind. His attention was already elsewhere, drawn by the complex weavings of auras that surrounded the dozens of Fold Dwellers making their way toward Aeternitas Concordia.
The stellar roadway that led to the Living Coalition Gateway was crowded with beings of incredible power and potential at the Originus Venerant stage.
Some as weak as those with 2 Million CQ and PQ, and other as strong as those exceeding 50 Million PQ and CQ!
It was there, among that clustering multitude, that Noah’s gaze fell upon something that made him stop and blink.
A figure that sparked recognition in the depths of his memory- someone who had no business being here, whose presence raised questions that demanded immediate answers.
How could there possibly be someone he recognized in this place?
Noah shook his head with calm incredulity as he studied the familiar silhouette.
There, moving with the measured pace of one accustomed to being the voice of reason in chaos, was a figure he remembered well from days ago.
Days, and yet it seemed like a while ago!
It was...
The Peacemaker!
Alexander Asmodeus, if his records served correctly!

The last time Noah had seen him, the man had been facing off against Bob with him in their native Wheel of Existence- a confrontation between powers that had seemed impossibly grand at the time but now felt quaint and weak in comparison to now.
For the Peacemaker to be here, in the Transcendent Origin Battlefront Folds, meant many possibilities and none.
Since he should have been a local of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds!
But Noah thought.
His mind worked with the rapid precision of a Weaver of Existence, sifting through memories and recent events with meticulous care.
Slowly. Rapidly.
And eventually...
The words of Royal Origin Calypso and Royal Law Tristesse echoed in his thoughts, fragments of conversation from the battle that had reshaped the very nature of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds.
And soon, his eyes brightened up at the only possible connection.
A treasure of the Living Laws that Altheon found within the Nullvein Gravewake Folds and sent back to them!
Could it be him? Could Alexander Asmodeus be the mysterious treasure that had drawn the attention of a Royal Living Law?
Noah’s eyes shone with the bright fire of curiosity as he adjusted his trajectory, floating toward the stellar roadway where the Peacemaker moved among the crowd of ascending Fold Dwellers.
Beside him, Sigrid noticed his change in direction but said nothing, content to follow his lead as they navigated the complex currents that surrounded them.
He was curious to know.
The threads of entanglements had brought them together once before, in simpler times.

Now, as they prepared to meet again in this place of glorious significance, Noah could only wonder what role the Peacemaker would play in the grand weaving that was slowly being woven around Fold Dwellers, Living Existences, and himself!
His curiosity, brilliant and irrepressible, demanded satisfaction. And he had never been one to deny himself!

sentences.text: The absence left by Altheon’s departure was immediate and palpable.

Noah’s gaze swept across the impossible view of Aeternitas Concordia, his eyes catching every detail with the methodical precision of one who understood that knowledge was power, and power was survival.
From his vantage point atop the triangular runic platform, he could observe the intricate dance of arrival and ascension that played out across this realm of infinite possibilities.

Other platforms materialized in brilliant flashes of authority- some bearing entire contingents of Fold Dwellers who moved with the coordinated precision of military units, others delivering solitary figures whose very presence seemed to bend reality around them.
Each arrival told a story.
The group that emerged from a hexagonal platform of crystallized time moved with the measured cadence of those who had learned to navigate temporal folds.
A lone figure stepping from a sphere of living shadow carried herself with the fluid grace of one who had danced with entropy and emerged unscathed.
Another cluster, their forms wreathed in elemental fury, bore the scars of battles fought in the elemental folds.
All of them, every single one, had earned their passage here through trials within Doorways!
They were the survivors who had looked into the abyss of Imitation Mutated Inevitabilities and emerged victorious!
Soon, they would all ascend to Aeternitas Concordia and receive their designations- labels that would define their roles in the weavings of war that stretched toward the Loom itself.
Noah found himself genuinely curious about what designation awaited him and Sigrid.

Would their origins in the Nullvein Gravewake Folds mark them as outcasts from Paradoxical Folds, or would Altheon’s subtle machinations behind the scenes provide some measure of protection for the one he called Young Miss?
The thought of Altheon brought a different sort of contemplation to Noah’s mind, one that carried with it the cold clarity of long-term planning.
The Prime Living Origin had played his role admirably thus far, bowing to Sigrid’s authority while maintaining the careful facade of respectful distance for Noah.
But Noah had not forgotten that this same being had tried to kill his other self, Ozymandias, not so long ago!
Altheon had acted without knowledge of who he truly faced, yes, but ignorance was no absolution for attempted killed of he- Noah Osmont!
In his mind, the Prime Living Origin was already marked for death, a sentence waiting to be carried out when the moment was right.
For now, though, Altheon served a purpose.
He was a tool- useful, efficient, and perfectly positioned to provide protection for him and Sigrid while maintaining the illusion of propriety.
If he proved valuable enough in that role, Noah was not averse to postponing his execution indefinitely.
Tools, after all, were only discarded when they broke or outlived their usefulness.
And if the day came when Altheon needed to be removed from the equation... well, Noah had Moiraine for precisely such situations.
The Living Golden Paradox had already proven her capability by eliminating one of her own kind with surgical precision.
A Prime Living Origin would present no greater challenge to her particular skills!
The thought brought a slight hum to his lips, a sound of quiet satisfaction that was lost in the glorious symphony that surrounded them.
He was preparing to move toward Aeternitas Concordia, to take Sigrid and begin their ascent into whatever wonder awaited them, when a familiar voice cut through his contemplations.
"Miss," came the oily tones of Master Neinoro, his approach heralded by the rustle of pristine white robes and the calculated smile that had become his trademark.
"You can always come with us to receive your designation under the Living Laws.
We wouldn’t want you to experience any hardship if you travel with others and receive no designation or worse yet, be labeled as coming from Paradoxical Folds."
HUUM!
The audacity of this fucker was immense.
Here, in this moment of glorious significance, this insignificant creature had the unmitigated gall to waste their time with his machinations!
The ingratiating smile, the false concern, the barely veiled threat disguised as helpful advice- it was all so predictably pathetic.
Noah could see Sigrid’s annoyance building, her stellar eyes darkening.
She was preparing to deliver what would undoubtedly be a devastating verbal assault, but Noah had enough of this guy.
"I’ve heard enough bullshit from you already," he said, his voice carrying the weight of absolute finality as he stepped forward.
His gaze locked onto Master Neinoro’s confident expression with the precision of a hunter sighting prey.
"So for now, stay here and do not move a step."
The words hung in the air for a heartbeat, deceptively simple in their construction.
Then Noah allowed a fragment of his true nature to surface- just enough to make his point with crystalline clarity!
HUUM!
The aura of an Early Creature could be expressed in many ways.
When wielded with benevolent intent, it could fill even Living Existences with euphoria so profound they would weep tears of pure joy.
But when turned to darker purposes, when infused with the cold displeasure of a being whose very existence predated the concept of authority itself...
Master Neinoro froze mid-breath.
His confident smile cracked like glass subjected to impossible pressure, the carefully constructed mask of superiority dissolving to reveal the stark terror beneath.

His eyes- those calculating orbs that had gazed upon Masters of Existence with casual disdain- now trembled like leaves in an existential hurricane as they stared at Noah with the horrified recognition of prey that had finally glimpsed its predator!
And it would not even know what type of predator had locked onto it!
The effect was immediate and absolute.

Every muscle in Neinoro’s body locked in place, held rigid by an instinctive understanding that to move, to speak, to even breathe too loudly might attract the attention of something that could erase him from existence with less effort than it took to blink.
Noah nodded at the sudden, blissful quiet that followed.
Without another word, he beckoned to Sigrid, and together they began their ascent toward Aeternitas Concordia, leaving behind a cluster of shock and confusion!
Behind them, Neinoro’s entourage rushed to his aid, shaking him, calling his name, trying desperately to break whatever weaving had fallen over him.

Their voices carried notes of genuine alarm as they struggled to understand why their leader- a being who commanded respect across multiple Wheels and Fold Dwellings, was cowering before what appeared to be nothing more than a Paradoxical Fold Dweller!
Many of them cast wary glances toward Noah’s retreating figure, their earlier dismissiveness replaced by a caution born of witnessing power they couldn’t comprehend.
But Noah paid them no mind.
His attention was already elsewhere, drawn by the complex weavings of auras that surrounded the dozens of Fold Dwellers making their way toward Aeternitas Concordia.

chapters.title: Chapter 3919: Aeternitas Concordia! II
paragraphs: The stellar roadway stretched before them like a river of crystallized starlight, its surface humming with the accumulated weight of countless footsteps of those walking or floating across it.
Each step Noah took sent subtle ripples through the luminous pathway, his existence exceptionally bright compared to others as the Living Existential Authority nearby seemed to distinctly sense it!
If he ever truly released a smidge of his actual aura...
Around him, the roadway teemed with life- a procession of beings who had earned their place through trials like the Living Origin Labyrinth.

The air itself seemed to thrum with the collective might of hundreds of Originus Venerant entities, their bodies radiating the silent authority of Towers of Origin. Among them moved the occasional Primarch, their more modest power signatures making them look feeble and likely among the first to die if they ventured towards the unexplored doorways of the Loom!
But Noah’s attention remained laser-focused on one figure among the throngs, his ancient eyes tracking the Peacemaker’s measured progress through the crowd.
As he drew closer, details began to resolve themselves with crystalline clarity, each revelation adding another layer to the puzzle that Alexander Asmodeus had become.
The man was not moving alone- a fact that immediately elevated Noah’s assessment of the situation from curiosity to active interest.
’Ho?’ The thought formed in his mind with the weight of genuine surprise, and Noah felt his lips curve into a smile that held both amusement and sharp calculation.
To the left of the Peacemaker walked a figure that, at first glance, appeared to be nothing more than a laid-back teenager whose casual demeanor seemed almost comically out of place among those here.
The young man’s hands were tucked casually into his pockets, his posture suggesting the kind of easy confidence that came from knowing exactly how dangerous you were!

But Noah’s enhanced perception cut through the carefully constructed facade as beneath the mundane appearance, waves of power rippled outward, and it was not the structured authority of an Originus Venerant.
This bum was a Living Law!
Noah felt his smile deepen as information began to cascade across his vision.
The being’s name resolved itself in elegant script before his eyes as his distinction of the Weaver of Existence borrowed his heavy Complexity.
|Kaedric Voss, the Mediator of Absolute Arbitration.|
Beyond that single line of identification, everything else dissolved into question marks!
Noah’s eyes sharpened.
Why would a Living Law accompany the Peacemaker so openly? What could Alexander Asmodeus possibly possess that would warrant such protection?
Even Altheon, for all his devotion to Sigrid and her identity, maintained the pretense of distance, watching from the shadows while allowing her to move through Existence with apparent independence.

But Sigrid was no ordinary being- she was already a Living Origin who had previously shattered her Tower, but she could still survive encounters even with other Living Existences as her previous power was slowly regained!
And...all Living Existences- Foldless Ones at least, not counting those labeled as [Young] Paradoxes or [Young] Origins, existed beyond the Originus Venerant realm.
So what made the Peacemaker so valuable that he merited open protection from a normal Living Law?
Noah’s gaze further shifted to Alexander’s right, where another figure walked with the measured grace of one accustomed to command.
She was striking in the way that dangerous things often were- beautiful, but with a deadly glare.
Her gaze swept the roadway ahead with the systematic precision of royalty, every movement radiating the kind of rigid discipline that spoke to a lifetime spent in positions of absolute authority!
Noah’s weavings focused on her like a magnifying glass, and once again, information began to flow across his consciousness.
|Seraphina Valorheart, Law Maker.|
His mind supplied, the name carrying with it undertones of nobility.
Her complexity though...was nearly ninety million Source Units, placing her towards the very pinnacle of what an Originus Venerant could achieve!
Yet even she walked beside the Peacemaker as if they were...equals.
Her position, slightly ahead, taking point, scanning for threats- spoke to her role as the one currently leading.
Noah absorbed all of this information as he continued his approach, his smile widening with each new detail that fell into place.
The Peacemaker himself remained partially obscured, his true nature hidden behind veils that seemed particularly potent.
But even through those protections, he could glimpse enough to understand that Alexander had undergone changes every bit as dramatic as his own.
The man’s power signature registered at over two million in both Complexity and Purity Quotients- a staggering advancement that spoke to rapid progression.
Hid eyes pulsed sharply.
How had someone else achieved such rapid advancement within the confines of the Nullvein Gravewake Folds...or after they left not too long ago?
Noah knew that beings like Alexander and the Great Usurper carried their own heavy flows of Existence- and he had even eclipsed them both in their Wheel of Existence!
But at this moment, wasn’t the Peacemaker carrying perhaps a bit too much weight compared to before?
Noah went forward through the crowd. His movement was unhurried, casual, as if he were simply another traveler making his way toward the Living Coalition Gateway.
But every step was calculated, every gesture designed to close the distance between himself and the answers he wanted.
And so...
When Noah finally spoke, his voice carried across the crystalline air with the weight of inevitability itself, cutting through the ambient noise of hundreds of conversations.
"Peacemaker."
HUUM!
The single word hung in the air like a bell that had been struck!
It was simultaneously a greeting, a recognition, and a challenge.
Alexander Asmodeus froze mid-step. For a heartbeat, genuine shock bloomed across his features!
It was the expression of a man who had thought himself safely anonymous, with nobody who could possibly know that distinction here!
But the shock lasted only a moment.
With little effort, he gathered his composure, turning slowly to face the source of Noah’s voice.

When his eyes met Noah’s across the crystalline expanse of the stellar roadway, they shone with their own inner light- the warm glow of genuine surprise mixed with something that might have been...relief?
"You?" he said.
He said!

chapters.title: Chapter 3920: Aeternitas Concordia! III
paragraphs: You.
A simple word, yet it carried within its single syllable the weight of recognition and surprise!
Noah and Alexander Asmodeus gazed at each other, their minds working in parallel streams of calculation and memory.
For beings of their caliber- an entire symphony of communication could unfold in the space between one heartbeat and the next.
For them, the mere span of an instant could potentially have hours of conversations!
Reality itself seemed to slow around them, creating a pocket of temporal stillness where minds could meet and speak without the cumbersome requirement of words.
Alexander was the first to break the silence, though silence was perhaps the wrong word for the complex web of mental communication that suddenly sprang into existence between them.
His consciousness reached, establishing a connection that nobody else could even listen to.

"I could be surprised and shocked and ask how you are possibly here," he said, "But anything is possible in the vastness of existence, so I won’t ask that. It is...good to see a familiar face from my home after all the craziness..."
There was something almost wistful in the way he said ’home,’ as if the concept had taken on new meaning since whatever occured recently!

"But the only thing connecting us and what I could at most be curious to know is... did you manage to kill Bob? I was planning to send another body of mine back to the Nullvein Gravewake Folds to finish him off entirely for the sake of my peace, but I have been kept... busy."
The last word carried undertones of frustration mixed with resignation, as if Alexander had discovered that power came with its own particular set of chains.
Around them, Existence remained frozen in that crystalline moment between recognition and response.
Seraphina Valorheart’s hand had begun to move in that short instant. But the motion hung incomplete, suspended in the weavings of compressed time while their two minds communicated in an instant!

Noah’s mental manifestation- a perfect reflection of his physical form rendered in thought and intention- appeared above his head in this frozen space as he looked towards a similar mental manifestation of the Peacemaker while he replied.

"Bob is actually a ridiculous cockroach to kill," he replied. "He has survived an Inevitability, Living Paradoxes, Living Origins... he is living large with the luck of a Protagonist right now. But you don’t have to worry about him."
The statement hung in the mental space between them, and Noah could see the exact moment when confusion flickered across Alexander’s consciousness.
The Peacemaker’s mental form leaned forward slightly, his expression shifting from casual inquiry to focused attention.
"What do you mean? Inevitability? Why is he no longer a worry? He led to the destruction of our Wheel of Existence, and for the sake of our peace..."
For the sake of Peace.
After he said this, his gaze flickered.
"...ah, maybe it does not matter anymore."
WAA!
Toward the end, Alexander’s mental manifestation shook its head with the gesture of a man who had learned to pick his battles carefully.

"You two at this moment may be evenly matched," Noah continued, his mental voice taking on the tone of someone delivering a diagnosis, "but he is not looking for you or anyone else, just obsessively trying to survive. He won’t threaten your peace. But Little Bobby truly does not matter. As someone who had a heavy flow of existence from our Wheel of Existence, I am curious about you. I heard a treasure of the Living Laws was taken from the Nullvein Gravewake Folds, and now you appear here..."
The effect of these words was immediate and profound. Alexander’s mental manifestation pulsed with surprise!
"How could you have possibly found that out?" Alexander asked, his mental voice carrying notes of alarm!

Noah’s mental manifestation smiled as he shook his head with gentle amusement, his gaze shifting to encompass the frozen figures of Kaedric Voss and Seraphina Valorheart that seemed to be moving in slow motion.
"Are you in any trouble?" he asked.

"I see a Living Law beside you, and that girl whose gaze has become extremely cold the moment I called out to you. As a courtesy from someone stemming from the same folds as me, I could lend a helping hand if you need help."
The offer hung between them!
Alexander’s mental form went still as surprise flashed through his consciousness.
The Peacemaker’s gaze shifted to the frozen figure of Seraphina, and Noah caught the flash of complicated emotions that flickered across his features.
When Alexander looked back, his expression had grown stern, as if he was wrestling with decisions that carried consequences far beyond everything imaginable!
"My Enneagram does not deem any malice from you and even shines differently compared to all others I’ve come across, and I trust it... even though it is the cause for my current situation..."
He paused, seeming to weigh his words with care.

"But it is okay," he finally continued, shaking his head with resignation. "I will figure it out myself. The Living Laws...claim something at the very heart of me was or is a part of a Relic tracing back to the earliest Living Laws. And this woman beside me, Seraphina...supposedly carries the other part. They say the two of us have to join and move as one in the future, but... my heart is bound to another. Even for the sake of Peace...we will have to see."
HUUM!
Noah blinked, his mental manifestation processing this revelation with the fascination of someone discovering an entirely new species of problem.
When he spoke again, his mental voice carried tones of genuine curiosity mixed with barely suppressed amusement.
"Your biggest problem was that you have to be with a second woman?"
Noah found such a problem uniquely amusing!
The Peacemaker nodded as he looked above at the distant continents and statues.
"I know. A seemingly...stupid or useless notion to some."
It was simultaneously admirable and limiting, the kind of romantic idealism that spoke to nobility of spirit while potentially creating insurmountable obstacles to practical solutions.
Noah’s mental manifestation shook its head with the exasperation of facing someone who had a stubborn adherence to impractical principles.
He approached Alexander’s consciousness as his mental hand came to rest on the shoulder of the Peacemaker’s projected form.

"Brother, I do not know much about you..." he said with earnest sincerity, "But you need to expand your horizons. Our hearts are big enough to love many. You would be surprised if I told you the number in my harem. If this is the biggest problem you are facing right now, I will leave you to it with that advice!"

As someone who had a heavy flow of existence from our Wheel of Existence, I am curious about you.
I heard a treasure of the Living Laws was taken from the Nullvein Gravewake Folds, and now you appear here..."
The effect of these words was immediate and profound.
Alexander’s mental manifestation pulsed with surprise!
"How could you have possibly found that out?" Alexander asked, his mental voice carrying notes of alarm!

Noah’s mental manifestation smiled as he shook his head with gentle amusement, his gaze shifting to encompass the frozen figures of Kaedric Voss and Seraphina Valorheart that seemed to be moving in slow motion.
"Are you in any trouble?" he asked.
"I see a Living Law beside you, and that girl whose gaze has become extremely cold the moment I called out to you.
As a courtesy from someone stemming from the same folds as me, I could lend a helping hand if you need help."
The offer hung between them!
Alexander’s mental form went still as surprise flashed through his consciousness.
The Peacemaker’s gaze shifted to the frozen figure of Seraphina, and Noah caught the flash of complicated emotions that flickered across his features.
When Alexander looked back, his expression had grown stern, as if he was wrestling with decisions that carried consequences far beyond everything imaginable!
"My Enneagram does not deem any malice from you and even shines differently compared to all others I’ve come across, and I trust it... even though it is the cause for my current situation..."
He paused, seeming to weigh his words with care.
"But it is okay," he finally continued, shaking his head with resignation.
"I will figure it out myself.
The Living Laws...claim something at the very heart of me was or is a part of a Relic tracing back to the earliest Living Laws.
And this woman beside me, Seraphina...supposedly carries the other part.
They say the two of us have to join and move as one in the future, but... my heart is bound to another.
Even for the sake of Peace...we will have to see."
HUUM!
Noah blinked, his mental manifestation processing this revelation with the fascination of someone discovering an entirely new species of problem.
When he spoke again, his mental voice carried tones of genuine curiosity mixed with barely suppressed amusement.
"Your biggest problem was that you have to be with a second woman?"
Noah found such a problem uniquely amusing!
The Peacemaker nodded as he looked above at the distant continents and statues.
"I know.
A seemingly...stupid or useless notion to some."
It was simultaneously admirable and limiting, the kind of romantic idealism that spoke to nobility of spirit while potentially creating insurmountable obstacles to practical solutions.
Noah’s mental manifestation shook its head with the exasperation of facing someone who had a stubborn adherence to impractical principles.
He approached Alexander’s consciousness as his mental hand came to rest on the shoulder of the Peacemaker’s projected form.
"Brother, I do not know much about you..." he said with earnest sincerity, "But you need to expand your horizons.
Our hearts are big enough to love many.
You would be surprised if I told you the number in my harem.
If this is the biggest problem you are facing right now, I will leave you to it with that advice!"

chapters.title: Chapter 3921: Aeternitas Concordia! IV
paragraphs: Noah stepped back from the space of shared consciousness with the easy grace of one accustomed to such things.
The quickest to react was, unsurprisingly, the hidden Living Law!
Kaedric Voss moved with fluid precision, stepping forward in a motion that seemed casual but carried within it the coiled readiness of a predator suddenly alert to potential threat.
His youthful features- still maintaining that carefully constructed facade of harmlessness- sharpened as his eyes swept over Noah and Sigrid with the systematic thoroughness of a Living Law.
Simultaneously, Seraphina Valorheart’s instincts kicked into full awareness.
Her hands found Alexander’s shoulders and pulled him back slightly while her body shifted to place itself squarely between him and them!
When she spoke, her voice carried the crisp authority of someone accustomed to being obeyed without question, but it was extremely cautious!
"Who are you?"
Noah’s response was casual, his smile deepening with what could only be described as genuine amusement.
"I am actually someone who is rooting for you, Seraphina," he said, his voice carrying encouragement!
Without waiting for a response, Noah turned and began walking away, his hand finding Sigrid’s with the natural ease.
Their departure was unhurried, almost leisurely, as if they were simply continuing a pleasant stroll.
Behind them, Seraphina stood frozen in shocked confusion.
She turned to Alexander with the sharp movement of someone seeking answers.
"Who are they?" she whispered,"You did not mention others knowing your identity..."

Alexander’s response was measured, delivered with the careful neutrality. His hands rose to gently remove hers from his shoulders, the gesture simultaneously intimate and distancing as he sought to reestablish the boundaries that were there.
"They are just some friends, nothing to worry about."
WAA!
Seraphina blinked, and a moment later, she tilted her head as she replied truthfully.
"You... do not have any friends."
"..." Alexander could not entirely deny this!
He offered no reply, choosing instead to release a sigh as he simply began moving forward.
Seraphina turned to Kaedric Voss.
The Living Law’s response was delivered with the lazy drawl of someone whose attention was already moving on to other concerns.
"Yeah, yeah, I’ll keep an eye on them," he said, his tone carrying casual dismissiveness.
"They are just mere Fold Dwellers."
In the distance, Noah’s smile widened as the words reached his hearing. His gaze shifted forward, focusing on the magnificent structure that awaited them just ahead.
The Living Coalition Gateway rose before them like a monument, its archway wrought from golden brilliance that seemed to pulse with its own inner rhythm.

The light that emanated from its surface was welcoming, carrying within it the promise of recognition and purpose that had drawn countless beings across impossible distances to stand before its threshold.
Each individual or group that passed through the gateway was subjected to a gentle but thorough analysis, their very essence examined and catalogued.

Within seconds of crossing that threshold, the results of that examination would manifest in the form of a rune- one of nine possible designations that would determine not just their immediate fate but their role in the Battlefront Folds reaching towards the Loom!

Noah watched with fascination as an entire group moved through the gateway’s embrace, their forms bathed in the analytical light before being marked with the multicolored brilliance that designated them as products of the Quantum Folds.
The newly designated Fold Dwellers passed through with expressions of hopeful anticipation, their steps carrying them toward what Noah now recognized as the next stage of their journey.
Beyond the gateway lay a white circular clearing that served as a gathering point for those who had received their designations.
His distinction as thr Weaver of Existence flashed as the identity of this space bloomed!
The Circle of Convergence!
The Circle of Convergence was surrounded by nine smaller statues, each one a scaled-down version of the magnificent monuments that crowned the floating continents above.

These statues served as more than mere decoration; they were conduits through which the Living Existences could observe and evaluate the assembled Fold Dwellers, their stone eyes occasionally flashing with the light of attention as Sponsors made their selections known.

Thousands of beings filled the space around the circle- Fold Dwellers of every conceivable description mixed freely with Living Existences who floated grandly or sat on thrones surrounded by others of the same Living Existential Authority.

The atmosphere thrummed with anticipation and barely suppressed anxiety as the resources and safety of the future of many hung in the balance of decisions made by beings whose motivations were unknown!
The group designated as Quantum Fold Dwellers took their positions within the circle, their nervous energy palpable as they waited for the judgment that would determine their immediate future.
Seconds stretched as they stood beneath the watchful gaze of the statues.
But the Quantum statue remained dark, its stone eyes reflecting nothing but indifference toward those who bore its mark.
Their confidence began to waver, each passing second adding weight to the possibility that they would be left unsponsored, unclaimed, and with no patron!
Then, just as despair began to creep into their expressions, salvation arrived in the form of a voice that echoed across the Circle of Convergence with the authority of a glorious proclamation.
|The Prime Living Temporal Porana has chosen to sponsor the Quantum Fold Dwellers on the square!|
HUUM!

Relief flooded their faces, their expressions transforming from anxiety to joy in the space of a heartbeat. A multicolored coin materialized above them, its surface wreathed in Living Existential Authority that made the very air around it shimmer with possibility.

The group’s leader reached up to claim their prize with trembling hands, bowing deeply before leading his companions toward the far side of the square where a shimmering golden veil concealed what appeared to be a marketplace buzzing with activity.
Noah observed this ritual with fascination, his mind already beginning to piece together the underlying mechanisms that governed Aeternitas Concordia!
The next arrival before the Gateway was a solitary figure whose very presence seemed to dim the light around him.
Dark-haired and cold-eyed, he carried himself with the casual confidence of someone who had long since stopped caring about the opinions of others.
The sword at his side rested in a sheath shaped like the hand of a clock, its presence adding an ominous note to an already intimidating figure.
Noahs weavings already observed this being and saw over ninety-five million in both Complexity and Purity Quotients, placing him among the most formidable Fold Dwellers!
When the gateway’s light touched him, a purple rune flashed above his head, marking him as a product of the Temporal Folds.
The dark-haired swordsman stepped into the Circle of Convergence with the unhurried pace.
He had barely taken his position when the air around him began to vibrate with competing authorities.
|The Prime Living Origin Dexus has chosen to sponsor the Temporal Fold Dweller on the square!|
|The Prime Living Elemental Firan has chosen to sponsor the Temporal Fold Dweller on the square!|
|The Prime Living Concept Adyan has chosen to sponsor the Temporal Fold Dweller on the square!|
The announcements came in rapid succession, each one accompanied by the materialization of a coin that pulsed with its own unique signature of power.
Noah watched with growing interest as multiple Living Existences competed for the privilege of claiming this particular prize, their offers manifesting as tangible tokens of their attention.

The swordsman surveyed his options, and after a moment’s consideration, he reached up to claim the largest bundle- five coins that shone with purple radiance, accepting the sponsorship of a Prime Living Temporal while politely declining the others through a series of respectful bows.
A few others past and underwent similar processes, until eventually...it came time for them!
As Noah and Sigrid finally approached the gateway itself, he found his mind buzzing with possibilities of how things would unfold.
"Let’s see." he murmured to Sigrid as they stepped up to the threshold.
Sigrid nodded, her expression carefully composed as they stepped forward together into the golden embrace of the Living Coalition Gateway.
The analytical light washed over them with a gentle intensity.
Then came the booming sound, drawing every eye nearby to focus on their position with magnetic inevitability!
HUUM!
The gateway flashed, its golden brilliance suddenly overwhelmed by something far darker and more ominous.
Deep obsidian light erupted from its archway like blood seeping through bandages, painting everything within sight in shades of contradiction and impossibility.

Above Noah and Sigrid’s heads, defying every expectation and shattering the careful order that had governed this place, a rune materialized in letters that seemed to burn against the very fabric of existence itself.
PARADOX!
Oh!
Paradox!

The word hung in the air like a curse made manifest, its presence transforming the Circle of Convergence from a place of hopeful anticipation into something that resembled a courtroom where the verdict had already been delivered!

chapters.title: Chapter 3922: Aeternitas Concordia! V
paragraphs: Paradox!
The blazing obsidian marking hung over Noah and Sigrid like an inescapable brand, its dark radiance pulsing through the golden atmosphere of the Coalition Gateway!
The very air around them seemed to recoil from the designation, as if existence itself was reluctant to acknowledge what they had been marked.
The Living Coalition Gateway, that magnificent archway of golden brilliance that had processed many with seamless efficiency, now trembled with uncertainty.
Noah raised his head with a widening smile, his eyes shining with an intensity that seemed to pierce through the veils to see the machinations beneath.
So... this was how they wanted to play things, was it?
Were Altheon and those behind him truly unable to alter their designations to mark them as those of Origin Folds, or was this something else?
Beside him, Sigrid’s expression became cold. Her stellar eyes lifted toward the skies as if she could see through the layers of reality to where Altheon lurked.
The moment she did so...
For only their ears to perceive, Altheon’s grand voice resonated.
|I’m sorry, Young Miss. You two were supposed to be branded with the designation of Origin Folds... I will check to see what occurred. But all other plans should still be in place.|
His voice carried a brooding quality, as if something had gone awry in calculations that should have been flawless.
But Noah shook his head at those words with the weary patience of someone who had long since learned that nothing in existence...ever occurred by mistake.
Nothing!
Every twist of fate, every apparent accident, was simply another thread in the weavings of magisterial existence!
Whatever had occurred was always what the plan had been. The question was simply whose plan it truly served.
Bathed in that accursed black light, Noah reached out to take Sigrid’s hand with deliberate casualness.
Together, they walked past the Coalition Gateway as the frozen masses of shocked observers finally found their voices, their paralysis breaking like ice.
"This..."
"Paradoxical Fold Dwellers!"
The shouts echoed through the Circle of Convergence like accusations hurled at criminals, each voice carrying its own particular blend of revulsion.
As if they were looking at pieces of shit!

In the surrounding spaces where Living Existences maintained their vigils, many pairs of ancient eyes turned to regard them with expressions that ranged from cold displeasure to barely contained hostility.
Why...would so many beings gaze upon Fold Dwellers simply because they originated from realms influenced by Living Paradoxes with such profound displeasure?
The answer lay in the fundamental weavings of guilt by association.
It was, quite simply, the sin of association!
Living Paradoxes were hated with an intensity that transcended anything and everything, their very existence seen as a cancer upon the ordered structure of Existence itself.

For surrounding the Loom...that ultimate prize that beckoned to every conscious being across the breadth of existence...lay countless horrifically powerful Inevitabilities that only came to be because of Paradox!
Everyone sought the Loom.

Everyone dreamed of reaching that quintessential destination where, it was believed, lay wonders and unfathomable answers relating to THE Creature...the being from whose essence all Living Existences had supposedly sprung from in the Stories of the Earliest Folds.
But over the eons, little progress had been made toward that ultimate goal, and the blame for that stagnation rested squarely... upon the shoulders of the Living Paradoxes.
Fucking! Living! Paradoxes!
Their very nature spawned Inevitabilities like infection breeding in an open wound, each paradox they embodied giving birth to new horrors that guarded the Loom.
The constant production of Inevitabilities had only increased exponentially over the years until entire regions of Doorways had become impassable death traps.
It was why Keys to new doorways empty of Inevitabilities were always sought by Living Existences!
So even Fold Dwellers who bore no personal responsibility for the actions of Living Paradoxes...found themselves branded with the same stigma.
This...was not the first time in history that beings associated with Paradox had appeared in Battlefront Folds!
In every previous instance, such unfortunate souls had been left to wither in isolation, unsponsored and unwanted, their potential wasted.
All eyes now focused upon Noah and Sigrid with pressure that might have reduced lesser beings, but Noah simply took Sigrid forward with the unhurried confidence!
They walked to the center of the square with measured steps, their bearing radiating a calm assurance that spoke to either supreme confidence or complete madness.

The Living Existences who floated grandly around the periphery of the square or sat upon thrones that pulsed with their own inner radiance regarded this display of composure with expressions of barely contained scorn.
How dare these marked creatures display such confidence in the face of existential disapproval?
A Living Spirit, her form wreathed in threads of ethereal energy that shifted between states of existence with each breath, finally gave voice to the collective sentiment.
"Do not take up too much time here," she called out with the cold precision.
"You will not be chosen anyway...!"
Her words died in her throat as something impossible occurred before the astonished eyes of every witness.
An obsidian coin materialized above Noah and Sigrid’s heads, its surface shrouded in a veil of Living Existential Authority so dense it seemed to bend light around itself like a miniature black hole!
A coin of sponsorship.
The voice that announced this development carried across the Circle of Convergence with the weight of glory!
|An Unknown Living Existence has chosen to sponsor the Paradoxical Fold Dwellers on the square!|
BOOM!
The announcement struck the assembled crowd like a physical blow, sending ripples of shock and disbelief through beings who had thought themselves prepared for any eventuality!
Clamor erupted from both Living Existences and Fold Dwellers alike as they struggled to process what they had just witnessed.
Who would sponsor Paradoxical Fold Dwellers?!
Even more disturbing than the sponsorship itself was the designation of "Unknown Living Existence."
What level of authority was required for a being to conceal their identity even here, in the heart of Aeternitas Concordia where all pretenses were supposed to be stripped away?!
